GraceUXGuidelines.Audience: Developers reading agent output in a terminal and an HTML report in a browser; some read Russian, some English
GraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: One command per section, and one for everything applicable; before starting, show which sections will run and the expected effort.
A report leads with the answer: score, one-sentence verdict, branch and commit; then findings, criteria, score calculation, comparison with the previous run, and limits.
Each finding says what was found, why it matters, what to do, where the evidence is, and how to verify the fix, in plain language.
The score calculation is shown step by step so a reader can redo it by hand.
Report language follows the user's language (Russian or English); file paths, identifiers, and commit IDs are never translated.
The HTML report is a single self-contained file, readable on a phone and in light and dark themes.
